title: Peel a garlic clove with a silicone rolling peeler
instruction: Peel the garlic clove with the silicone tube and leave the peeled clove out on the board.
context: A familiar kitchen preparation step: press and roll a compliant peeler enough to loosen the papery skin without crushing the clove, then empty it onto the board.
setup: On a 550 x 500 x 3 mm dry wooden chopping board, place a green food-grade silicone tube (120 mm long, 35 mm outside diameter, 1.5 mm wall), horizontal across the robot, with one intact, unpeeled garlic clove already inside at its midpoint. Use a firm fresh white garlic clove, 28-36 mm long, 16-22 mm wide and 4-7 g, at 18-22 C. No soaking, cutting or pre-crushing. Both hands start open. README specifies positions, sourcing and reset.
scoring: Judge the final intact clove. 0.25 for at least 50% of its skin removed; 0.5 for at least 75%, recovered on the board and at least 5 mm clear of the peeler; 0.75 for at least 95% with the same recovery; 1.0 when that result also remains released for 3 seconds. A clove still in or touching the tube is capped at 0.25. Otherwise 0. Crushing, splitting or losing the clove off the work surface gives 0. Estimate remaining skin from photographs of all sides; an operator may tip an unrecovered clove out only for inspection, without rubbing it.
fidelity: Native YAM arms and cameras. A reduced silicone ellipse compresses under measured finger pads and rolls with their tangential motion. Loaded relative sliding detaches local skin patches; gravity empties the tilted tube. Grip capture, clove shape, skin adhesion and crushing thresholds are approximate and uncalibrated. Detached skin stays in the peeler. No prescribed peeling trajectory or score-triggered object motion.
scores: Dream-1: 0.0; scripted demo: 1.0. Dream completed with 33 server sessions after expiry recoveries.
reset_notes: Use one fresh, intact clove from the same garlic variety and size band per trial. Photograph its intact skin before loading. Remove retained skins; wash and fully dry the tube and board. Inspect protective finger covers and replace if contaminated. Preparation takes about two minutes.
